intro-ecosystems-interactions.alt: A table of five interactions between two species, with + for helped, minus for harmed and 0 for not affected. Mutualism: + and +, bees and flowers. Commensalism: + and 0, barnacles on a whale. Parasitism: + and minus, a tick on a deer. Predation: + and minus, an owl eating a mouse. Competition: minus and minus, two plant species shading each other. Mutualism, commensalism and parasitism are the three kinds of symbiosis.
